note: ReXGlue recomp, D3D12 renderer; finishable solo or co-op, split-screen, online co-op over LAN/VPN, KB+M. v1.3.5 (22 Oct), prebuilt exe. Needs your own EU Xbox 360 copy + TU2.
ReXGlue recomp with its own plume renderer; races, Crash mode, audio and videos work, plus online play. Installer needs your own EU or US disc image.
XenonRecomp build of the 360 version: campaign, multiplayer, split screen, private matches over Steam or LAN. Needs a v1.0.557 disc; no public matchmaking.

game: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (Xbox Live Arcade)
note: Recompiles the 2007 XBLA release with the ReXGlue SDK, not the PS1 original. v1.4.5 (Aug 2026), with title-update builds and Linux ARM64. Needs your own dumped XBLA package.

project: Dead Rising 2: Case West Native PC Port
note: XenonRecomp port, playable start to finish; online co-op via the XenonLive launcher. v1.1.2 is the author's final build. Needs your own XBLA package.
XenonRecomp port of the XBLA prologue, completed start to finish solo and in online co-op. v1.1.3 is the final release; the author has stopped work. Needs your own package.
ReXGlue recomp with input-lag patches (3 to 1 frame), arcade-tuned slowdown and a boss training mode. Needs your own disc or GoD ISO plus Title Update 1.

game: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3 HD Collection
note: ReXGlue port with its own launcher, mod kit, online versus (beta) and extra modes. Needs your own default.xex and region data or the full ISO; several new modes are still beta.
Native recompilation with its own D3D12 / Vulkan renderer since v2.0 (more than twice the frame rate of the emulated renderer, per README). Needs your own Xbox 360 copy.
The first XenonRecomp port: high resolution and frame rates, ultrawide, mod loader. Stable 1.0.x releases. Unofficial Android port by SansNope (APK, Adreno GPUs).
Unofficial port of the Xbox 360 version with graphics settings, native mouse and keyboard aiming, and wide controller support. v1.0.0 is out. Bring your own game files.
ReXGlue recomp; README says playable end to end with DLC, 60 FPS, ultrawide. v0.3 (20 Oct); installer builds from your ISO. Needs a D3D12 GPU with ROVs and your own Xbox 360 copy.
ReXGlue recomp built from your own USA/Europe Rev 1 disc image, with GGPO rollback, ranked lobbies and practice mode. Versus only; based on mahmoud-mess/tekken6-recomp.
ReXGlue recomp with a native renderer, mod manager, unlocked FPS. 1.14.0 (24 Oct) adds Mac and iOS; renderer backend source not public. Needs your own retail disc.

project: WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 PC Port
note: ReXGlue port up to 4K/60 with ultrawide, custom entrance music and movies, a Mod Maker and an Android build. Installs from your own Xbox 360 disc image.
ReXGlue-based port with 60 FPS, resolution scaling, ultrawide and mouse controls. Beta releases; README warns of bugs and crashes. US version of the game only.
ReXGlue recompilation with a native renderer and online play through Epic Online Services. Releases are still betas; leaderboards don't work and Linux builds are untested.
Never on PC. XenonRecomp with its own D3D11 renderer; all 15 levels play, unlocked fps, mouse and keyboard. Pre-release, campaign only.
Second CoD3 port, ReXGlue and D3D12. v2.0 adds recompiled multiplayer with system link and a server list; README says only the first mission was verified.
ReXGlue recompilation with keyboard and mouse controls. The README says it is playable but a work in progress, so expect bugs and crashes.
XenonRecomp port with DLSS/FSR, PC controls, subtitles; optional AI-upscaled HD pack. v1.07 (26 Oct) adds a Linux/Steam Deck installer (testing). Needs your own Xbox 360 game files.
ReXGlue port with its own Vulkan renderer; README says fully playable start to finish, with DLC and up to 240 fps. Beta releases for Windows; Linux via source or Proton. Own ISO needed.
US (NTSC-U) release only. Installs from your own ISO; ultrawide, up to unlocked fps, DLSS/FSR, in-game settings and online lobby. Linux package runs the Windows build through Wine.
ReXGlue port with the TRG launcher (display, graphics, controls, achievements, cheats). Installs from your own XBLA package, exact xex 1.0.0.11 only.
Prebuilt releases play with your own Xbox 360 or PS3 copy, any region; building it yourself needs the Xbox 360 PAL version. Mod manager and overlays. Same author as NocturneRecomp.
ReXGlue recompilation of the GOTY release that can be played to the end. Has a launcher, uncapped frame rate and keyboard/mouse. Higher resolution, Vulkan and Linux are still to come.
ReXGlue recompile; 2.0 renderer based on AnDr3zF's Deck port (D3D12/Vulkan). Free online beta on community servers (EU/SA). Needs your own Xbox 360 ISO.
Launcher builds the game from your own copy (GoD package or disc 1 ISO). Single player played through; self-hostable online server. Windows build only tested under Proton.
Playable preview built on your PC from your own disc (USA release only); rendering bugs, AMD and Intel GPUs not qualified.
Vulkan recomp with launcher; races hold 60 fps (120 optional) and System Link online works. Career and split-screen need more testing. Needs your own EU or US disc image.
ReXGlue port of the Ultimate Collection (USA): menus, Free Play and races at 60 FPS; full career untested, no Xbox Live. Launcher installs from your own two discs.
Experimental alpha built with a ReXGlue fork: menus, races, saves and early career work; stutter and rendering issues.
ReXGlue port with a launcher for both discs, Project Forza Plus 4 support and experimental wheel force feedback. Menus and races work; career untested. Needs your own USA Rev 1 discs.
ReXGlue recomp of the retail game; Act 1 played through, rest smoke-tested; co-op, System Link, Horde. v0.3.7 (26 Oct), exe holds game code; Android experimental. Own disc.

game: Gears of War 2, Gears of War 3 and Gears of War: Judgment
note: Three recompiled Gears games in one launcher with its own D3D12 renderer: up to 5K, DLSS/FSR/XeSS, unlocked fps, Gears 2 split-screen. v0.2.2; Linux via Proton. Own discs plus latest title updates.
ReXGlue SDK recomp with a launcher, high frame rates, local achievements and offline leaderboards. Linux and Steam Deck experimental. Needs your own XBLA package.
Port of LibertyRecomp (via its Android fork) to jailbroken PS5: GTA IV plus both Liberty City episodes, 4K60, DualSense features. v1.0.2. Needs your own USA disc image and Title Update 8.
AOT recompilation for ARM64 iPhone and iPad with a direct Metal renderer; no JIT needed. Unsigned IPA for sideloading. Needs your own USA retail copy plus Title Update 8.
ReXGlue recomp based on re-gh2; XInput guitars work. Test version with audio lag and 720p lock; no updates since March 2026.
Recomp of TU23 with a Windows installer that needs your own extracted disc and TU23 file; DLC and real or emulated Toy Pad supported. Public beta, D3D12 only.
Self-described experimental native port. Imports your own four-disc set, with disc swapping, HDR, upscalers and frame-rate options. Ships no game data.
Separate ReXGlue project for the Complete Edition: menus, free roam and races work, correct physics above 30 FPS. No releases; build it yourself with your own extracted game.
Complete Edition only. Recompiled code is generated on your machine by a build script. Career and races play on D3D12. Vulkan is barely tested.

game: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations
note: Closed-source XenonRecomp port aimed at phones (Mali/Adreno, Vulkan), fights at 30 fps; also a Windows build. Needs your own US disc files with the exact default.xex.

project: Naruto: Rise of a Ninja Recomp
note: ReXGlue port with a native D3D12 renderer at 60/120 fps, DLC support and a launcher. Work in progress: bugs and crashes expected. Installer imports your own Xbox 360 ISO.

game: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005, Xbox 360)
note: ReXGlue recompilation, not SpeedBreaker. Playable with rough edges; multiplayer broken. Needs your own ISO, though releases ship nfsmw.exe and an Android APK.
XenonRecomp-based; up to 4K and ultrawide. Needs your own US Xbox 360 disc (not the PC version). Windows coming soon.
Native Windows port with a launcher that installs from your own disc image; up to 8K, 240 fps, FSR/NIS. Gets past the VENTURE freeze that stops Xenia. Linux via Proton only.
ReXGlue recomp; races, AI and graphics work, but one car freezes the game and Geometry Wars crashes. Run via a .bat pointing at your own extracted disc. v2 planned.
ReXGlue port with up to 4x resolution and ultrawide. Early test releases, tested on one PC so far; Linux build experimental. Needs your own USA Xbox 360 disc image.
ReXGlue port of the Xbox 360 game: Free Skate, career and replays, unlocked FPS, 2x rendering. One game revision only; needs your own extracted files.
Kinect is emulated so a pad works; real Kinect and webcam motion on Windows. Menus and races play, much still untested. Installs from your own USA/EU disc image.
XenonRecomp port, up to 4K/60, all 59 fighters, rollback over Steam and Ranked on community servers (v0.1.7). Installer builds it from your own USA/Europe disc image plus Title Update 3.
A separate ReXGlue/XenonRecomp port. 0.9.8 pre-release (12 Oct 2026); README says the whole campaign is playable. USA/Europe disc, no title update. Download includes translated game code.
Native x64 port with a D3D11 renderer. The README reports full gameplay with mouse look, video settings and saves. Releases are still 0.1.x pre-releases.
ReXGlue port that the README calls playable on Linux, Steam Deck and Windows, with Vulkan and D3D12 renderers. Still 0.0.x releases with known issues listed.
ReXGlue recompilation with a native Vulkan renderer and a launcher. Matches and entrances run at 60 fps; beta releases with GPU-specific glitches listed in the README.
ReXGlue port of the Xbox 360 version with a launcher. v1.0.0 out, a few days old, with known lighting and frame-rate issues. Needs your own game plus title update 1.0.3.
Earlier, separate ReXGlue attempt. Gets in-game with likely bugs per README; source only, no releases, no commits since March 2026.
Bare-bones ReXGlue recompilation, build from source only. The README says it reaches in-game but is not playable yet.
ReXGlue recompilation of the XBLA version: boots and is drivable, no in-game audio yet. No release; build it with your own XBLA package.
A separate group's ReXGlue project based on GOTY TU1. Source only, with no releases. The README lists goals rather than a playable state.
ReXGlue port aimed at Android phones: boots, menus and races, but frame rate is far below the console's. Preview APKs; reads your own disc image (.iso).
README says early development and not meant for public use. GTA IV also has an official 2008 PC version.
ReXGlue recompilation; early but playable, arcade mode tested at 60 FPS on one PC. v0.2.1 (23 Sep). Needs your own retail XEX.

game: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst
project: Naruto Storm 3 Full Burst Port Nativo
note: Closed-source XenonRecomp-based port aimed at Android phones (Vulkan, touch controls), plus a Windows build. Fights at 30 FPS per README. Needs your own NTSC-U copy.
XenonRecomp build for ARM64 Android phones, no PC build. Boots and plays a match on a Snapdragon 865; work in progress. Needs your own EU Xbox 360 disc, about 6.5 GB.
XenonRecomp/XenosRecomp port of the Xbox 360 game. No releases yet: README says it is not meant for public use until an official release. Needs your own game files.
ReXGlue port of the 2007 game: 60 fps, up to 4K, ultrawide, mouse and keyboard, System Link co-op. Launcher installs from your own disc dump; Crackdown 2 support in beta.
ReXGlue port of the 2008 original by TheSaltTrader, released Sept 2026. The original repository now returns 404; copies by others keep the source but have no release builds.

sources.label: Copy of the source at v1.0.20, evil84 (README checked 2026-10-20)
DSOGaming: Unofficial PC Version of Ninja Gaiden 2 Released (16 Sept 2026)

note: N64Recomp-based native port with RT64 rendering, widescreen, high frame rates and mods; v1.0.x releases. Needs your own copy of the game.
N64Recomp port with RT64: high frame rates, widescreen and ultrawide, mod support, faithful audio, Steam Deck. Release 1.1.1. Needs your own North American v1.1 ROM.
N64Recomp port on RT64 with widescreen, high frame rates, mouse/gyro aiming and mods. Played through to the end; US ROM only. Ready-made builds need your own ROM.
N64Recomp port with Classic and Modern modes: widescreen, high frame rate, free camera, twin-stick aiming. Needs your own US ROM; no macOS build yet.
Recomp with widescreen, interpolated frame rates, online play, custom tracks and a built-in mod store. Needs your own US v1.0 or Rev A ROM.
N64Recomp port with the RT64 renderer: widescreen, high frame rates, in-game menus and gyro aim. Not built from the DK64 decomp, though it uses its research. Needs your own copy.
Built from the GoldenEye decompilation. Full solo campaign and 2-4 player split-screen; pre-1.0, US ROM only. AI-assisted per README.
N64Recomp port with mod support. v1.2.2 (25 Sep) for Windows, Linux and macOS; an Android fork exists. Needs your own US ROM.
N64Recomp port with RT64: widescreen, high frame rates, mods and texture packs. Releases (v0.9.2) are on GitLab; needs your own US ROM.
HarbourMasters port on libultraship; first stable 1.0.0 release in Feb 2026. Only the US version is supported. Ships no copyrighted assets; you supply your own copy.
Harbour Masters port on the Paper Mario DX / pmret decompilation. 1.0 since Sep 2026; needs your own US ROM, assets extracted on first launch.
Builds the Pilotwings 64 decompilation from your own ROM on first start. v1.5.1 (21 Oct): 21:9, high refresh, gamepads, split screen; Android experimental.
N64Recomp port with RT64; plays like the cartridge by default, with optional widescreen, high frame rate, gyro/mouse aim and photo export. Needs your own US ROM.
N64Recomp port with 60 fps, widescreen, max LOD, split-screen upgrades and experimental online play and MK64 track import. Linux build experimental. Needs your own USA v1.0 ROM.
Rush 2 recomp with widescreen, interpolated high frame rates, online races and mods. Add your own Rush 1, Rush 2049 or California Speed ROMs to play their tracks too. Own Rush 2 ROM.
N64Recomp + RT64 port: widescreen, high frame rates, mods and texture packs, Steam Deck support. Stable v2.0.2 releases. Needs your own North American copy.
N64Recomp port with RT64 and mod support; v1.0.3 is the latest release. Sibling project to Starship. Needs your own copy of the game.
HarbourMasters port built on the SF64 decompilation; v2.0.0 release. Base asset extraction needs a US version; EU/JP voices can be added. Ships no copyrighted assets.
HarbourMasters port on libultraship; 3.0.0 adds Android and iOS. Supports US and JP versions. Ships no copyrighted assets; you supply your own copy of the game.
PC port on the n64decomp source with online co-op for up to 16 players and Lua mods; regular releases (v1.5.1). Needs your own US ROM; ships no assets.

game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
note: Decomp-based PC port in the Ship of Harkinian family; stable releases (5.0.1) with DX11, OpenGL and Metal renderers. Ships no assets; you supply a supported copy of the game.

game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
note: Built with N64Recomp and the RT64 renderer; stable releases with widescreen, high frame rates and mod support. Needs your own copy of the game. Ocarina of Time support is planned.

game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
note: PC port built on the OoT decompilation and libultraship, with frequent stable releases (9.3.1, 18 October 2026) and many enhancements. Ships no assets; you supply a supported copy of the game.
N64Recomp port on RT64 with widescreen, high frame rates, extended draw distance and an optional modern water renderer. 1.0 releases. Needs your own USA Rev A ROM.
Unofficial N64Recomp and RT64 port, not from the BanjoRecomp team. Alpha 4 releases; much of the code is AI-generated (disclosed). Needs your own NTSC-U 1.0 ROM.
Built from the Body Harvest decompilation with N64Recomp; README says playable start to finish with real audio. Widescreen, texture packs, rebindable controls. Beta v0.10.2. Own US or PAL ROM.
GoldenEye64Recomp app for iPhone/iPad (Metal, touch, controllers); Mac alpha. v0.2.2 (30 Sep) is a recipe only: build and sideload it with PadMint on a Mac. Needs your own US ROM.
N64Recomp port with RT64, widescreen and high frame rates. Releases are still tagged dev (v0.2.0-dev). Needs your own copy of the game; Goemon's Great Adventure is planned.

game: Ogre Battle 64: Person of Lordly Caliber
note: N64Recomp port of the USA Rev A cartridge; PLAN.md says the game runs end to end with saves. Releases for Win/Linux/macOS plus a browser build. Needs your own ROM.
Harbour Masters' PaperBoat with Apple touch controls. Releases hold no app: PadMint builds an unsigned IPA on your Mac; you sideload it and import your own US ROM.
WIP port of the PD decomp: single player and split-screen work, with mouselook, widescreen and 60 FPS. Minor bugs and occasional crashes; only CI dev builds. Needs your own copy.
N64Recomp/RT64 port; mouse aim, widescreen (experimental), Android touch, texture packs. 0.2.5 (27 Oct), self-described beta. Needs your own Japanese ROM (English patch OK).

game: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire
note: N64Recomp port, playable open beta; widescreen, rebinding, texture packs. 0.9.6 (22 Oct); the release folder carries stock texture PNGs for editing. Needs your own USA ROM.
Native recompilation with full English and Chinese translations, widescreen and an optional redrawn HD art pack. v0.5.2; Windows, Deck, Android and Switch builds experimental. Own Japanese ROM.
Japan-only sequel to VPW64, same author and N64Recomp + RT64 stack; beta, pre-release builds. Needs your own ROM.
Japan-only AKI wrestler, recompiled with N64Recomp + RT64 by the World Tour author; beta, pre-release builds. Needs your own ROM.

project: WCW vs. nWo World Tour: Recompiled
note: N64Recomp + RT64; playable end to end with local 4-player, widescreen and saves. Pre-release builds. Needs your own USA ROM.
Same author and N64Recomp + RT64 stack as the World Tour recomp; beta, pre-release builds. Needs your own ROM.
N64Recomp + RT64; menus, matches, sound, rumble and flash saves work. Pre-release builds. Needs your own ROM.
Part of the same author's AKI wrestling recomp family (N64Recomp + RT64); beta, pre-release builds. Needs your own ROM.
N64Recomp-based, with the Zelda64Recomp menu. Work in progress toward stable gameplay; v0.2.28 (22 Oct) builds for Windows, Linux, macOS. Needs your own ROM.
Windows fork of SacredFire on bbport/shadPS4. v0.4: FSR 4, frame gen, ultrawide, EU edition. Offline only. Needs your own CUSA13795/CUSA14876 dump + 1.21 update.
Runs the PS4 game's own code with replacement system libraries and a shadPS4-based Vulkan renderer. Up to 4K, local co-op. Installs from your own decrypted PKG; Linux experimental.
Built on SacredFire/bbport with a shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer. Career, saves, private online. v0.1.14 (21 Oct). Needs your own CUSA06534 dump + 1.14 update.
Runs the PS4 game's own code with a runtime written for this game and a shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer. Frequent releases; known crashes listed in the README.
A shadPS4 fork with patches for this game (EU release). One release (v1.0), not updated since.
Built on the gow3_pc runtime with shadPS4 graphics: 60 FPS (higher experimental), up to 4K, all languages. Needs your own US or EU copy as a folder or fake PKG.
C++ and Vulkan rebuild that loads the data from your own PS4 copy.
Native Windows runtime on the bloodborne_pc loader with shadPS4 graphics; playable to the credits (0.60.3). Needs your own CUSA08809 dump and two sound modules from your console.
Native Linux runtime; Windows build in Supermedo's fork. A full play-through is not verified per the README.
Same core as tlg_pc: game code runs natively, PS4 system reimplemented, GPU translated to Vulkan. 30 fps gameplay on Linux; saves/open world still in testing, Windows untested.
Fork of HayatoG’s iss_pc. v0.3.8 (25 Oct): first missions play, 35-45 fps on an RTX 4070 Super; 4 GB GPUs crash. No game files shipped. Needs your own dump (EU CUSA00897 tested).
Native port: the game’s own x86-64 code runs on a rebuilt PS4 runtime, GPU via Vulkan. First chapters play, 20-30 fps on an RTX 2060. Needs your own CUSA00223 1.07 dump.
Runs your eboot.bin natively on a custom PS4 runtime with the shadPS4 video core; from wipeout_pc. v0.1.4 (26 Oct): first chapters play up to 120 fps. Needs your CUSA00068 1.10 dump.
shadPS4 fork and launcher with fixes for this game, tuned for NVIDIA on Windows. 0.5.0 is faster but flickers more than 0.4.0. Needs your own game dump.
Runs the game's own x86-64 code with a game-specific runtime and shadPS4 graphics; forked from the God of War III port. Prologue verified so far.
All three games from one launcher; DLSS / FSR and frame generation. Known crashes in Uncharted 2 and 3.
Runs the PS4 executable natively with about 700 reimplemented system functions and shadPS4's video core. Played through chapter 1, not to the end. Needs your own CUSA36381 1.04 dump.
Runs the PS4 code natively on a PS4 runtime with the shadPS4 Vulkan core. Menus and HD/2048 races play; not every mode tested. v0.2.23 (26 Oct); Linux from source. Own PS4 dump.
PS4 code runs natively; Sony libraries reimplemented, graphics via shadPS4's Vulkan renderer (Windows) or a custom Metal renderer (Intel Mac). Needs your own dump.
shadPS4 fork tuned for Driveclub: launcher, 30/60/120 FPS, ultrawide. Needs your own dump and system files from your own console.
Despite the name, native execution with reimplemented PS4 libraries and Vulkan, not a static recompilation. Races playable per README; no online.
Experimental preview on the UFC 3 port's runtime; Fight Now and early Career tested by the author. One release, 0.0.11-preview.1 (17 Oct). Needs your own CUSA14209 v28.00 dump.
Built on the gow3_pc / bloodborne_pc runtime with shadPS4 graphics. Gameplay works in 10+ minute sessions; Windows not yet tested in game.
Menus and races work offline; no online play. Fork of Ryty with a shadPS4-derived renderer.
PS1 code reverse-engineered back to C, no emulation; fully playable since 2020, build 8.0 (July 2026). Needs your own discs.
Static recompilation with a custom renderer; v0.4.2 for Windows and Linux, macOS later. Source not public yet. Needs your own NTSC-U disc (SCUS-94228).
Java reimplementation of the disassembled PS1 code (not a matching decomp). 3.0.0 out, fully playable per README. Needs your own four US discs.
All four PS1 Twisted Metal games behind one launcher, with widescreen and 60 FPS for 1 and 2; v1.0.0 (13 Oct). Needs your own USA discs.
psxrecomp port, v0.3.37 (11 Oct) for Windows, Linux and macOS. Needs your own disc. No licence file.
psxrecomp showcase title; the author calls releases in-development previews with rough edges (known issues listed). Needs your own copy of the USA game.
Open beta (v0.5.1b) made with BlackLabelHQ's RecompOne, using the SOTN decomp for naming and patches. Widescreen, randomizer and mods; 1.0 not out yet. Needs your own copy of the USA PS1 version.
RecompOne-based recomp built on first launch from your own USA disc (SCUS-94900, .chd or .cue/.bin). Widescreen, up to 240 fps, mods; widescreen still shows edges in some levels.
Native SDL3/OpenGL port on the CTR-ModSDK decompilation. Playtest betas (beta-7.1, July 2026) with open bugs. Needs your own NTSC-U disc image.
PC port built from the matching decompilation; beta releases for Windows and Linux. Needs your own disc image. Same team runs a DW2 Online project.
Native port of the five PAL releases: 1080p, true 16:9, HD sprites and textures, CRT filter, save states. Program code ships translated; graphics and sound come from your own disc.
Open beta (v0.2b) made with RecompOne, using the MediEvil decomp for naming and patches. Expect game-breaking bugs before 1.0. Needs your own copy of the USA PS1 version.
Separate psxrecomp-based project (v0.1.3, release-candidate builds). Needs your own copy of the USA game plus a retail SCPH-1001 BIOS dump; OpenBIOS is not supported.
psxrecomp port of the USA release with widescreen and an alpha X + Zero two-player co-op mod, local or netplay. Playtest builds; needs your own disc image, OpenBIOS included.
Recompiler and runtime that turn PS1 executables into C#; needs no BIOS. A developer tool, not a playable port. Powers the MediEvil and Symphony of the Night recomp betas.
Source port of the PAL release (SCES-00650) on a PSY-Z compatibility layer, with a modern renderer and widescreen. Alpha releases; assets imported from your own disc.
Native port compiled from the PS1 decompilation via PsyCross, AI-assisted. Fully playable per README; Linux and macOS still in progress. Needs your own copy.
Both PS1 games in one PC recompilation; v1.0 (24 Sep) for Windows, gameplay video still marked work in progress. Needs your own discs. No licence file.
Byte-matching decompilation of the USA game ported to PC: up to 4x resolution, widescreen, 3D monsters, mods and a card editor. Needs your own USA disc image.
Matching decompilation of the US Rev 1 game, about 99.6% of main functions byte-exact. A PC port on PsyCross is planned but not started; nothing to play yet.
psxrecomp port with an optional experimental VR mode; Windows alpha v0.1.6 (22 Oct). Needs your own disc. No licence file.
PSXRecomp-based port, release candidate v0.1.1 (30 Sep) for Windows, Linux and macOS; gameplay not confirmed yet. Needs your own disc and a PS1 BIOS.
Builds on the FoxdieTeam mgs_reversing work. alpha.1 (10 Oct), gameplay untested by the author. Needs your own USA discs.
PSXRecomp port, v0.1.1 (30 Sep); builds and launches, the release notes make no claim about gameplay. Needs your own disc (SLES-02529) and a PS1 BIOS.
psxrecomp-based browser build by Kem0x, first at pepsiman.ol.mr, later on his VL.MR site. On 2026-10-21 the site, repo and VL.MR page were all gone; no takedown notice found.
psxrecomp-based; boots and plays with rendering, input and memory-card saves, plus a CD-audio stutter fix. Windows releases (v2.1). Needs your own copy of the USA game.
Playable start to finish on Vulkan at up to 4x resolution, with save states. No release; the installer builds it from your own European disc (SLES-54627).
PS2Recomp + paraLLEl-GS on Vulkan: up to 16x resolution, widescreen matches, 4 players. The release is a setup tool that builds the game from your USA disc (SLUS-20639).
Hybrid static recomp (EE and VU code precompiled, PS2 hardware modelled, PCSX2 GS renderer). Locked 60 FPS, up to 8K; v1.2.5 (26 Oct). Installer holds the precompiled game. Needs your US v2.00 ISO.

game: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (plus Jak II, Jak 3)
note: Decompiled GOAL code rebuilt with the team's own compiler for x86-64. Jak 1 complete; Jak II and Jak 3 in beta but completable. Needs your own PS2 disc.
PS2Recomp with the PCSX2 renderer: 60 fps, up to 8x resolution, DLSS, online play on a community server. Browser build experimental. Needs your own USA ISO.
Native reimplementation checked against a PS2Recomp build; playable start to end on Windows, other platforms untested on hardware. v1.1.1 (25 Oct). Needs your own PS2 disc.
Decompiled PS2 games rebuilt natively: Ratchet & Clank playable, Going Commando, Up Your Arsenal and later games in progress. Launcher v0.9.0 (25 Oct). Needs your own discs.
Both US discs built with ps2-web-recomp and streamed by the site; solo or 4-player online on a Bioserver-based room server. Closed source so far; developer not named on the site.
MIPS code translated to C++ with PCSX2's GS underneath: native 60 fps, real widescreen, up to 8x resolution. Steam Deck installer included. Needs your own USA disc (SLUS-20002).
